jobs.title: Agile Developer - Level 2
jobs.description:
Wyetech is a small business founded in June 2007, built on a simple vision that hasn’t changed since day one: hire awesome people, compensate them well, and channel their enthusiasm into making customers happy. That commitment shows up in our benefits, including a best-in-class retirement plan: Wyetech contributes the equivalent of 20% of your salary to your SEP IRA, helping you build real long-term financial security. Our mission is to give employees the best possible environment to thrive while delivering stellar services and solutions for our customers and their missions. We call it engineering happiness: for our customers, and shared by the talented team that makes it happen.

**Agile Developer Level 2**
===========================

**Job Description**
-------------------

Wyetech is seeking an Agile Developer Level 2 to support the modernization of a legacy operational system using a microservices-based architecture and cutting-edge technologies.

The Microservices Developer will be responsible for:

* Writing java spring boot based micro service applications utilizing AWS native technologies
* Building REST services with Spring able to filter and select complex data objects
* Implement CI/CD principals utilizing Maven, Gitlab and GitOps
* Agile development and delivery of software
* Communication and collaboration: Software Development is a team-oriented discipline. Engineers need to be able to communicate and collaborate effectively with other team members, as well as with stakeholders.

**Required Skills/Qualifications**
----------------------------------

* Bachelors degree from an accredited college in a related discipline, or equivalent experience/combined education
* 6 years of relevant experience or a Master’s degree plus 4 years of relevant experience.
* Ability to support an on-call rotation

**Desired Skills**
------------------

Candidates should possess at least two of the following:

* Java, Spring boot or python
* Microservice architectures
* CI/

jobs.description:

ACTIVE SECURITY CLEARANCE AT THE TS/SCI POLYGRAPH LEVEL IS REQUIRED
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Data Systems & Sustaining Engineer to provide direct technical support to the Enterprise Data Office (EDO). In this role, you will work in close coordination with cross-functional capability teams to ensure the reliability, integrity, and evolution of sustained software products and analytics suites.
  
The primary focus of this position is the identification, root-cause analysis, and triage of complex data errors across ingestion and processing pipelines, as well as the onboarding and validation of new data archetypes into existing operational systems. The ideal candidate brings deep software engineering fundamentals in Python and Java, paired with a solid grasp of network protocols and geospatial data structures.
  
  
The annual base salary range for this role is $213,000-$252,000 (USD) , which does not include discretionary bonus compensation or our comprehensive benefits package. Actual compensation offered to the successful candidate may vary from posted hiring range based upon geographic location, work experience, education, and/or skill level, among other things.
